verdict.rationale: First-party docs show the full CLI lifecycle: `uv add` updates pyproject.toml and also the lockfile and environment, `uv remove` removes packages, and `uv lock --upgrade-package` upgrades one package while keeping the rest of uv.lock intact. Extras such as `uv add --script`, `uv add -r` for requirements migration and a documented CLI reference further reduce any need to hand-edit files. missing for 10: explicit statement that `uv remove` also rewrites the lockfile, independent or hands-on corroboration of safe manifest/lockfile rewriting.
